'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Rafah offensive]], [[Refugee camp airstrikes in the Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Tel al-Sultan massacre]]
****Between 47 and 52 people are killed in an [[Israel]]i [[Rafah displacement camp airstrike|airstrike]] and subsequent fire in a tent camp for displaced civilians in [[Rafah]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-05-26-2024-eb25eb70d2c7b9e6bcd0497060eccbca (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-attack-rafah-tent-camp-draws-global-condemnation-2024-05-27/ (Reuters)]
**[[Insurgency in the North Gaza Strip]]
***A spokesperson for [[Hamas]]'s [[Al-Qassam Brigades]] claim that they captured [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] soldiers in [[Jabalia]] yesterday. However, the IDF denies this claim. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hamas-armed-wing-says-fighters-captured-israeli-soldiers-gaza-fighting-israeli-2024-05-25/ (Reuters)]
**The Al-Qassam Brigades fire rockets towards [[Tel Aviv]], Israel, for the first time in four months. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckrr0e3y29po (BBC News)] [https://www.elconfidencial.com/mundo/2024-05-26/guerra-israel-hamas-gaza-directo-hoy_3890338/ (''El Confidencial'')]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Five Hezbollah militants, five civilians killed and two civilians injured in IDF strikes on [[Aitaroun]], [[Naqoura]], [[Ayta ash Shab]], [[Hula]] and [[Yaroun]] in [[southern Lebanon]].[https://today.lorientlejour.com/article/1415133/hamas-claims-to-have-taken-soldiers-prisoner-in-gaza-israeli-army-denies-it-gaza-war-day-233.html (L'Orient le Jour)]
*[[Mali War]]
**More than twenty civilians are killed in an attack by unidentified gunmen in a village in [[Mopti region]], [[Mali]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/over-20-killed-attack-central-mali-village-2024-05-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**The [[Houthis]], with assistance from the [[International Committee of the Red Cross]], free more than 100 detainees in [[Sana'a]], [[Yemen]], in a "unilateral humanitarian initiative" to pardon prisoners and return them to their families. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/yemens-houthis-free-more-than-100-prisoners-2024-05-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Armenia–Georgia floods]]
**At least three people have been confirmed dead in [[Armenia]] following flooding on the [[Armenia–Georgia border]], with several bridges collapsing as a result of the flooding. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/one-dead-villages-cut-off-after-flooding-armenia-georgia-border-2024-05-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Enga landslide]]
**The [[International Organization for Migration]] estimates that more than 670 people were killed in the landslide in [[Enga Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]], on Friday. [https://apnews.com/article/papua-new-guinea-landslide-yambali-enga-642d9e8e0c913efa25ed2d67df318393 (AP)]
*[[Tornado outbreak sequence of May 19–26, 2024]]
**The death toll from an overnight tornado outbreak in the [[U.S.]] states of [[Texas]], [[Oklahoma]], and [[Arkansas]] increases to 15. [https://www.pilotonline.com/2024/05/26/at-least-11-dead-in-texas-oklahoma-and-arkansas-after-severe-weather-roars-across-region/ (''The Virginian-Pilot'')] [https://apnews.com/article/tornadoes-weather-texas-oklahoma-93001e1d81f120d0d55c8dfa24938250 (AP)]
*Ten people are killed and 39 others are injured in a collision between a bus and three other vehicles on a highway near [[Mersin]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/ten-dead-39-injured-southern-turkey-highway-collision-2024-05-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Formula One World Championship]]
**Charles Leclerc wins the Monaco Grand Prix for the first time in his career, becoming the first Monégasque to win his home race in 93 years. [https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/leclerc-overjoyed-with-breakthrough-monaco-win-as-he-says-previous-heartache.6aEgxXMtsAMt7UJFkU2GH0 (''Formula 1'')]
*[[2024 IIHF World Championship]]
**Hosts [[Czech Republic men's national ice hockey team|Czechia]] wins the title for the seventh time after beating [[Switzerland men's national ice hockey team|Switzerland]] 2–0 in the final. Czechia ends their 14-year gold drought by winning it for the first time since 2010. [https://www.tsn.ca/hockey-canada/david-pastrnak-s-third-period-goal-lifts-czechia-over-switzerland-in-gold-medal-game-1.2126487 (''TSN'')]
*[[2024 Indianapolis 500]]
**In [[auto racing]], [[Josef Newgarden]] wins the [[Indianapolis 500]] for the second consecutive year, becoming the first driver to do so since [[Hélio Castroneves]] in 2002. [https://www.barrons.com/news/josef-newgarden-wins-indianapolis-500-375fb9b6 (''Barron's'')]

**In [[cricket]], the [[Kolkata Knight Riders]] defeat the [[Sunrisers Hyderabad]] in the final of the [[Indian Premier League]] to win their third IPL title.
